scope: The reviewed runtime switch of the staging broker (build order PR 7; ADR-0029 item 10, which this record implements in place of infra/labs/e2b-activation.json for the new runtime port; ADR-0035 item 6). Committed off: the broker reads no E2B_API_KEY even if the owner placed it ahead of the switch, RuntimeBroker.runtimeExecute and runtimeSweep answer BROKER_HELD (RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE) before any input, database or provider access, the E2B adapter (build order PR 8, apps/broker/src/runtime-e2b.ts) is composed but no template is pinned (the owner's build of infra/e2b/morrow-computer) and nothing is qualified, so no sandbox can be created, and no sandbox the provider does not find is ever counted as absent. cleanup_only reconciles and kills (the sweep) and creates nothing; on also admits creates. `on` needs qualification first (ADR-0029 item 11, under ADR-0035 item 4): qualified_on and the docs/evidence/live/ record of the canary run (egress denied, the envd token unreadable by the guest user, timeouts that kill without pausing); any template, region or adapter change voids it. `merchant` admission (the owner's product data rather than synthetic data) needs `on` and qualification. The runtime image is the staging broker's var MORROW_RUNTIME_SWITCH (exactly on or cleanup_only) and E2B_API_KEY in its secrets.required, both only while the switch is not off; edge:check refuses any mixed state. While off the owner may still place the key ahead of the switch, only with `npm run staging:put-secret -- E2B_API_KEY --while-runtime-off`, read from the owner's chmod-600 file e2b-api-key and never from argv; gate 6 and secrets-status then accept it present or absent. provider_usage_limit_usd records the E2B project's usage limit, set in the owner's E2B account and enforced by E2B, never by Morrow's code (packages/policy/src/runtime-computer.ts runtimeCaps carries the same value): it is the outside backstop since ADR-0039 item 6 removed the code's US$10 monthly runtime budget (migration 0052), and E2B's refusal sets the runtime hold that only a person lifts (ADR-0029 item 9). Production has no switch until the ADR-0007 item 9 custody ADR.
